source_note: Facts cross-checked against the app's question bank and standard references.

bullets.en: Unification: Prithvi Narayan Shah; the Kathmandu Valley was captured in 1768 (1825 BS).
bullets.ne: एकीकरण: पृथ्वीनारायण शाह; 1768 (1825 वि.सं.) मा काठमाडौं उपत्यका विजय।

bullets.en: Kot Parva (1846) → Jung Bahadur seized power; Rana rule ran 1846–1951.
bullets.ne: कोतपर्व (1846) → जङ्गबहादुरले सत्ता हातमा; राणा शासन 1846–1951।

bullets.en: Anglo-Nepal War 1814–16; Treaty of Sugauli signed 4 March 1816; the British commander was David Ochterlony.
bullets.ne: अङ्ग्रेज–नेपाल युद्ध 1814–16; सुगौली सन्धि 4 मार्च 1816; ब्रिटिस सेनापति डेभिड अक्टरलोनी।

bullets.en: Treaty of Friendship (1923): Britain recognised Nepal as an independent sovereign state.
bullets.ne: मैत्री सन्धि (1923): बेलायतले नेपाललाई स्वतन्त्र सार्वभौम राज्य मान्यो।
चन्द्र शमशेरले सिंहदरबार बनाउन लगाए (1908 मा सम्पन्न)।

bullets.en: First Jana Andolan (1990) → multiparty democracy and the Constitution of 2047.
bullets.ne: पहिलो जनआन्दोलन (1990) → बहुदलीय प्रजातन्त्र र 2047 को संविधान।

bullets.en: Royal palace massacre: 1 June 2001. King Gyanendra's direct rule began 1 February 2005.
bullets.ne: दरबार हत्याकाण्ड: 1 जुन 2001। राजा ज्ञानेन्द्रको प्रत्यक्ष शासन 1 फेब्रुअरी 2005 देखि।

bullets.en: Second Jana Andolan (2006, 19 days) → the monarchy was abolished on 28 May 2008 (15 Jestha 2065).
bullets.ne: दोस्रो जनआन्दोलन (2006, 19 दिन) → 28 मे 2008 (2065 जेठ 15) मा राजतन्त्र अन्त्य।

bullets.en: Lichhavi era = a golden age of art and learning (Amshuverma a notable king); Malla era = art and architecture.
bullets.ne: लिच्छवि काल = कला र शिक्षाको स्वर्णयुग (अंशुवर्मा उल्लेखनीय राजा); मल्ल काल = कला र वास्तुकला।

bullets.en: Prithvi Narayan Shah's Dibya Upadesh: 'Nepal is a garden of four castes and thirty-six sub-castes.'
bullets.ne: पृथ्वीनारायण शाहको दिव्योपदेश: 'नेपाल चार जात छत्तीस वर्णको फूलबारी हो।'
